title: ICDS selects pedagogical digital twins project for Rising Researcher support
body: Penn State’s Institute for Computational and Data Sciences selected “Composite Pedagogical Digital Twins: Modeling and Synthesizing Instructional Strategies from Educational Data” for its Rising Researcher Collaborations Program. The project, led by principal investigator Suman Saha and co-principal investigator Mahfuza Farooque, was one of 17 funded projects selected from 123 faculty proposals. Award ICDS_RR26_030117 provides graduate stipend and tuition support for Rising Researcher Vani Guha in spring 2027.
